text:
elaine: Thanks everyone for the all-hands. Following up in this live thread for any remaining questions about hybrid/remote travel, hub passes, and offsites — drop short Qs and we’ll answer live :)

maya: quick clarifier — policy hasn’t changed: any work-related travel over $500 needs manager + finance pre-approval. exceptions for team offsites are noted below. :memo:

devin: For desk/hub bookings: use the badge portal or `#book-desk` slash command. Example: ` /book-desk SF-hub 2026-06-14 ` — ops will confirm within 24h.

leo: Reimbursements — keep itemized receipts and upload to Expensr within 30 days. If you need an advance for travel, submit the Travel Request form: https://intra.redwood.com/travel-request and choose "advance".

sam: For company offsites we’ll cover core travel + shared lodging. Personal partner/spouse travel isn’t covered unless pre-approved for business reasons. We’ll publish the offsite travel cookbook in the handbook next week.

jordan: @leo quick Q — any change to per diem rates? Planning multi-city travel.

leo: No change to rates this quarter. If you do multi-city, include a short itinerary and we’ll prorate per diem.

nina: Childcare stipend question from a teammate: is there a childcare travel stipend for parents attending mandatory in-person events?

maya: Short answer: yes, limited stipend for dependent care when travel is required by the company. Submit with receipts and note "dependent-care" on the expense. Policy will be in the updated handbook section.

caroline: Satellite office passes — if you need recurring access to a satellite hub, fill out this request: https://intra.redwood.com/hub-pass and ops will issue a 30/90-day pass depending on role. Part-time visitors get day passes.

elaine: For managers — please remind teams to request travel at least 10 business days ahead to allow approvals and booking. Offsite coordinators: ping me if you need help with vendor contracting.

devin: Adding a quick how-to snippet for booking common vendors:
```
1) Fill travel-request form
2) Wait for finance approval email (1-2 biz days)
3) Book via approved vendor list or get pre-approval for other vendors
4) Keep receipts + upload to Expensr
```

jordan: Is there a reimbursement cap for remote-first coworking when traveling? e.g., daily coworking fee for month-long travel.

maya: We’ll cover reasonable coworking costs when travel is company-sponsored. For extended personal travel, please coordinate with your manager. We'll add examples to the handbook to avoid ambiguity.

sam: Appreciate the questions — leadership is aligned on keeping flexibility but minimizing surprise costs. We’ll share a one-pager summary and update the Travel & Workspace handbook by EOD Friday.

elaine: Awesome — keep questions coming and we’ll update the thread with links/edits. :rocket:
